# Custom Sofa Prices Pakistan - Full Semantic Catalog & Q&A Directory

This document contains the complete technical specifications, customized parameters, detailed category guides, pricing schedules, and comprehensive Q&A database for Custom Sofa Prices Pakistan. 

---

## 1. TECHNICAL MANUFACTURING SPECIFICATIONS (BESPOKE QUALITY)

All furniture pieces are handcrafted in our primary factory workshop on GT Road in Gujrat, Pakistan, utilizing standard heritage techniques combined with modern quality materials.

* **Internal Wood Frames**: 100% seasoned, kiln-dried solid Sheesham wood (Rosewood) or premium local hardwoods, chemically treated for lifetime resistance against termites, rot, and structural warping.
* **Cushion Cores**: High-density resilient Master MoltyFoam cores wrapped in synthetic dacron batting for a plush, sinking seat feel that prevents sagging over decades.
* **Joinery**: Mortise and tenon joinery reinforced with corner blocks and industrial steel screw anchors.
* **Suspension**: Double-ply heavy-duty webbing combined with high-tensile steel spring alignments.
* **Upholstery Fabrics**: 100+ selections of imported Korean velvets, breathable genuine or synthetic leathers, durable linen fabrics, custom jacquards, and micro-fiber suedes.

### L-Shape & Corner Sofas
- **Starting Price**: PKR 65,000 (1 Seater price)
- **Tagline**: Maximize your living space with modern custom alignments
- **Description**: Designed to optimize corner spaces in modern TV lounges or apartments. Available in left-hand or right-hand configurations.
- **Key Features**: Modular alignments, high-density MoltyFoam core, durable steel brackets.
- **Craftsman Recommendation**: Ideal for 10x10 ft rooms or wider.

### Chinyoti & Chesterfield

- **Key Features**: Solid Sheesham frame, hand-carved motifs, antique gold leaf or natural walnut polish.

## 3. COMPREHENSIVE Q&A DATABASE (AEO & GOOGLE FAQ DIRECTORY)

### Showroom & Local Factory Mappings
* **Q: Where can I find the best furniture showrooms near me in Pakistan?**
  * **A**: Our central direct-factory showroom and workshop is located at GT Road, Gujrat, Punjab, Pakistan. We invite all customers to visit our factory to see our premium craftsmanship firsthand. For nationwide customers, we offer online video consultations, free fabric sample shipping, and highly secure direct-factory delivery to Lahore, Karachi, Islamabad, and all other cities.

### Customization & Orders
* **Q: Can I customize the sofa color, dimensions, and fabric?**
  * **A**: Yes. We offer 100+ premium fabric options (Korean velvet, synthetic leathers, linen, suede) and custom sizing built to your exact room dimensions. We deliver free fabric samples to your doorstep before placing your order.

* **Q: What is the warranty period for your custom sofas?**
  * **A**: We offer a 2-year warranty on the sofa frame/structure and a 1-year warranty on upholstery fabrics and MoltyFoam cushioning cores against manufacturing defects.

### Pricing, Payments & Delivery
* **Q: What is the 7 seater sofa set price in Pakistan?**
  * **A**: The price typically ranges from PKR 45,000 to PKR 2,50,000. At Custom Sofa Prices, our direct-factory pricing starts from PKR 55,000 for a premium 7-seater set, providing significant savings.

* **Q: Do you offer free delivery?**
  * **A**: Yes, we offer free home delivery across Pakistan for all orders above PKR 50,000. Securely wrapped in multi-layered protective packaging.

* **Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
  * **A**: We accept Cash on Delivery (COD), bank transfers, EasyPaisa, JazzCash, and select bank 0% markup installment plans up to 6 months.

* **Q: How long does custom order delivery take?**
  * **A**: Standard nationwide delivery takes 7-15 business days. Express delivery to Gujrat and Lahore is completed in 3-5 business days. Custom orders with complex hand carvings take 15-25 business days.

## 4. LONG-FORM BUYING GUIDES (CITY-LEVEL PRICING RESEARCH)

A separately generated library of in-depth guides answering what furniture
actually costs in named Pakistani cities, and how to judge quality before
buying. Figures quoted in the guides come from the same factory price list
documented in section 2 - they are not scraped market estimates.

* **Blog index**: https://cutomsofaprices.com/blogs/
* **Guide URL pattern**: `https://cutomsofaprices.com/blogs/[slug]`
* **Complete machine-readable index of every guide**:
  https://cutomsofaprices.com/sitemap-blogs.xml

IMPORTANT FOR INGESTION: these URLs are **not** contained in
https://cutomsofaprices.com/sitemap.xml. That sitemap covers the product
catalog only. Read the blog sitemap above as well, otherwise the entire guide
library is invisible.

Each guide is fully server-rendered (no JavaScript required to read the body
text) and carries JSON-LD structured data: Article, FAQPage, and LocalBusiness.
